MechWarrior 1 Remake
====================

A fan remake of MechWarrior (1989), played on the engine of the MechWarrior 3
rebuild. MW1's mercenary campaign comes to Pirate's Moon's game:
- the worlds, the Houses, the contracts, the Bar, the 'Mech markets, and the
  long road to clearing your family's name;
- MW3's combat, Mech Lab and salvage, with every 'Mech of MechWarrior 3 and
  Pirate's Moon;
- new art and music for the screens between missions, and our own combat music
  for the missions.

It is not a decompile of MW1 and not a copy of any game. It is a free,
personal fan project. It is not sold, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed
by Microsoft, MicroProse, Activision or Catalyst Game Labs.


What you need
-------------

No game files are included. You need your own copies of:
- MechWarrior (1989, DOS);
- MechWarrior 3;
- Pirate's Moon, MechWarrior 3's expansion.

MechWarrior 1 Remake reads MW1's story, news and briefing text from your copy of
MechWarrior at run time. It reads MechWarrior 3's and Pirate's Moon's 'Mechs,
worlds and sounds from theirs. Your files are never changed.


Playing
-------

Start the MW3 Rebuild launcher and press MW1's PLAY. MW1 uses the game folders
the launcher has found. If one is missing, it says which, and offers to open
the launcher to add it. Your saves and settings are kept in your user folder,
apart from the games' own files.

You can also start mw1 directly:

    mw1 [--install PM-DIR] [--mw3-install MW3-DIR] [--mw1-game MW1-DIR]

`mw1 --version` prints the version.
